name: Technical Support
description: Product errors, degraded performance, access failures, integrations, or troubleshooting. Excludes billing and account administration.

name: Billing Inquiry
description: Questions or disputes involving invoices, charges, refunds, discounts, payments, renewals, or subscription pricing.

name: Account Management
description: Login credentials, user profiles, access ownership, duplicate accounts, and account lifecycle requests.

name: Product Feature Request
description: Requests for new capabilities or changes to existing product behavior.

name: General Inquiry
description: How-to, documentation, or policy questions that do not report a defect or request billing or account changes.
